content_sections.heading: Gujarat GSSSB Municipal Accountant Vacancy 2026 Out
content_sections.text: The notification specifies a category-wise breakup of the 82 total vacancies as follows. Within these totals, seats are also reserved for women candidates in each category as per government rules, and 8 posts are earmarked for ex-servicemen. The notification states that no seats are currently reserved for persons with disabilities (PwD) under this particular recruitment, since backlog PwD vacancies for this cadre are being filled separately under a special recruitment drive. However, PwD candidates whose disability matches the nature of the post's duties can still apply against unreserved vacancies, subject to conditions specified in the notification. The notification also clarifies that the number of vacancies shown may increase or decrease before the recruitment process is completed.

content_sections.heading: GSSSB Supervisor Instructor Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must fulfil the following eligibility conditions to apply for the Municipal Accountant post. The candidate must be a citizen of India or possess a nationality as specified under Rule 7 of the Gujarat Civil Services Classification and Recruitment (General) Rules, 1967. Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Computer Application, Commerce, Science (Mathematics/Statistics), or Arts (Statistics/Economics/Mathematics) from a university or institution established or incorporated by a Central or State Act, or recognised as a deemed university under the UGC Act, 1956; or an equivalent qualification recognised by the Government. Basic knowledge of computer applications as prescribed under the Gujarat Civil Services Classification and Recruitment (General) Rules, 1967. Adequate knowledge of Gujarati or Hindi, or both. Important note: Candidates holding a B.Sc. (CA & IT) or M.Sc. (CA & IT) degree are not eligible for this post. Candidates who have appeared for the qualifying degree examination but whose result is not yet declared, and those who intend to appear for such an examination, are also eligible to apply for the Preliminary Examination. However, proof of passing the qualifying examination must be submitted along with the Main Examination application; the date of passing the qualifying degree examination will be treated as the last date for filling the Main Examination form. Candidates should hold a certificate or mark sheet from a recognised training institution confirming basic computer knowledge, or a diploma/degree/certificate course in computers, or should have studied computer science as a subject in a diploma/degree course or in Standard 10 or 12. Candidates who do not currently hold such a certificate may still apply, but they must produce it before appointment; failure to do so will result in cancellation of selection.

content_sections.heading: GSSSB Supervisor Instructor 2026 Salary Structure
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will initially be appointed on a fixed monthly pay for the first five years, and will move to the regular pay scale thereafter, subject to satisfactory service. Regular appointment in the pay scale after five years is subject to satisfactory service review and remains subject to the outcome of pending Supreme Court proceedings (SLP No. 14124/2012 and SLP No. 14125/2012), as mentioned in the notification.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit for GSSSB Municipal Accountant Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: As on August 21, 2026, the candidate's age must not be less than 20 years and not more than 35 years. Age relaxation is available as per government rules. Candidates already in Gujarat Government service may also get upper age relaxation as per the Gujarat Civil Services Classification and Recruitment (General) Rules, 1967.

rows.relaxation: Period of service rendered plus 3 years

content_sections.heading: GSSSB Supervisor Instructor Apply Online 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates can apply online for the Municipal Accountant post only through the OJAS portal. No offline or physical application will be accepted. Candidates must ensure that the photograph used in the application is a recent, passport-size photo with a white background, taken no earlier than one year before the last date of application, and the same photograph copy must be used at every stage of the recruitment process, including the exam attendance sheet and document verification.

content_sections.heading: Gujarat GSSSB Municipal Accountant Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: At this stage, candidates are required to pay only the Preliminary Examination fee. Fees must be paid online through Debit Card, Internet Banking, UPI, or Wallets, along with the applicable transaction fee, by August 23, 2026, 11:59 PM . The fee paid is refunded only to candidates who actually appear for the examination; candidates who do not appear will not receive a refund. Applications without fee payment will be automatically rejected.

content_sections.heading: GSSSB Municipal Accountant Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The recruitment process consists of two stages. Stage 1 – Preliminary Examination (Objective/MCQ): A screening test of 150 marks, conducted in CBRT/OMR mode, to shortlist candidates for the Main Examination. Marks scored in the Preliminary Examination are not counted towards the final merit list. Stage 2 – Main Examination (Descriptive): Consists of two papers of 100 marks each. The final merit list is prepared based on marks obtained in the Main Examination only. Approximately seven times the number of advertised vacancies will be shortlisted for the Main Examination, based on availability. Candidates must appear in both papers of the Main Examination; absence in either paper renders the candidate ineligible for selection. Each question carries 1 mark, and 0.25 marks are deducted for every incorrect answer (negative marking). The Gujarati and English language papers are set at the Standard 12 (Higher Level) equivalent, while Paper 2 is set at a degree level standard. Preliminary Examination: 40% marks for all categories. Main Examination: 40% marks in each paper for all categories.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in GSSSB Municipal Accountant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 82 vacancies for the post of Municipal Accountant, Class-3, under the Commissioner of Municipality Administration office.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for GSSSB Municipal Accountant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application process starts on August 1, 2026, and the last date to apply is August 21, 2026 (11:59 PM).

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification for GSSSB Municipal Accountant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates need a bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Computer Application, Commerce, Science (Mathematics/Statistics), or Arts (Statistics/Economics/Mathematics), along with basic computer knowledge and knowledge of Gujarati or Hindi. B.Sc. (CA & IT) and M.Sc. (CA & IT) degree holders are not eligible.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for GSSSB Municipal Accountant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 20 and 35 years of age as on August 21, 2026, with age relaxation applicable for reserved categories, women, and persons with disabilities as per government rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for GSSSB Municipal Accountant?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a fixed monthly pay of Rs. 49,600 for the first five years, moving to the regular pay scale of Rs. 39,900–1,26,600 (Level-7) thereafter, subject to satisfactory service.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for GSSSB Municipal Accountant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The Preliminary Examination fee is Rs. 500 for unreserved candidates and Rs. 400 for reserved category candidates. At present, only the Preliminary Examination fee needs to be paid, by August 23, 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for GSSSB Municipal Accountant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection involves a Preliminary Examination (screening only) followed by a Main Descriptive Examination of two papers. The final merit list is based solely on Main Examination marks.

faq.question: Q8. Is there negative marking in the GSSSB Municipal Accountant exam?
faq.answer: Yes, in the Preliminary Examination, 0.25 marks are deducted for every incorrect answer. In the Main Examination, 1/4th of the marks allotted to a question is deducted for an incorrect answer under the pro-rata evaluation method.

faq.question: Q9. When will the GSSSB Municipal Accountant exam date be announced?
faq.answer: The exact examination date has not been announced in the notification. Candidates should regularly check gsssb.gujarat.gov.in for updates on the exam date and admit card.
